title: 第2537章 一剑斩神王第2536章 斩天剑君
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 但一切反抗在化域境的斩天剑意面前，都显得如此苍白无力！他甚至连一句完整的惊呼都无法发出！
没有惊天动地的爆炸，只有一声轻微却令人心胆俱裂的闷响。
剑罡如切败革，毫无阻碍地从壮汉神王的天灵盖贯入，自胯下透出！
时间仿佛在这一刻彻底静止。
壮汉神王脸上的惊骇与绝望永远定格。
他那魁梧雄壮的神王之躯，如同被最精密的激光切割过，沿着中轴线，无声无息地裂开成两半！
切口光滑如镜，甚至能看到内部瞬间被剑气湮灭、失去所有生机的脏腑与骨骼断面！
狂暴的永生之力失去了主人的驾驭，如同无头苍蝇般从裂开的躯体内疯狂逸散，旋即被残余的剑意彻底绞灭，化作虚无！
两片残躯带着喷溅的、尚未落地便被剑气蒸发的神王之血，朝着下方血色戈壁无力地坠落。
方羽的身影，如同鬼魅般出现在壮汉神王原先站立位置的前方，背对着那坠落的残尸。
他单手持着光华流转、不染滴血的星辰剑，剑尖斜指下方血色大地，姿态孤高而淡漠。
他甚至连眼神都未曾瞥向那化为两片的尸体，只是淡淡地开口，声音平静得没有一丝波澜，却蕴含着睥睨天下的孤傲。
“神王四重的臭虫，蝼蚁而已。”
话音落下，方羽缓缓转过身，那双深邃如寒星的眼眸，不带任何感情地，落在了后方那三位已然彻底石化的永生会神王身上。
此刻，那美艳少妇脸上的媚笑早已消失无踪，取而代之的是无法置信的惊恐与苍白，娇躯不受控制地微微颤抖，看向方羽的眼神如同在看一尊从地狱爬出的魔神！
那瘦高老者阴鸷的眼神被无边的骇然填满，握着武器的手指关节捏得发白，周身气息剧烈波动，永生之力都变得紊乱不堪！
就连那一直沉默寡言、气息最为凝练的青年神王，此刻也瞪大了双眼，脸上第一次露出了恐惧的表情，嘴唇微张，却发不出任何声音！
空气死寂，唯有星辰剑发出细微的嗡鸣，以及峡谷下方传来的、两片沉重残躯砸落在戈壁乱石上的闷响。
方羽的目光，如同冰冷的剑锋，缓缓扫过这三张写满惊骇的脸。
“轮到你们了。”
两片光滑如镜的神王残躯砸落在血色戈壁之上，沉闷的撞击声如同丧钟，伴随着方羽的话，狠狠敲击在剩余三位永生会神王的心头。
空气仿佛被彻底抽干，死寂得可怕，唯有星辰剑细微的嗡鸣声，如同催命的低语，在凝固的空间中回荡。
美艳少妇脸上的媚笑早已消失得无影无踪，取而代之的是无法置信的惊骇与深入骨髓的恐惧。
她娇躯不受控制地剧烈颤抖，原本流转着勾魂摄魄光泽的眼眸此刻只剩下无边的恐惧，死死盯着那持剑而立的孤高身影，如同在看一尊从九幽深渊爬出的魔神！
那轻描淡写的一剑，斩灭的不仅是神王四重的同伴，更是她身为神王的骄傲和胆气！
“怎……怎么可能……”
content_en:
But all resistance seems so feeble in front of the Heaven-Destroying Sword Intent in the Realm of Transformation Realm! He couldn't even utter a complete exclamation!
"Poof!"
There was no earth-shattering explosion, just a slight but heart-rending muffled sound.
The sword's blade was like a piece of leather, penetrating through the strong man's divine king's Heavenly Spirit Cap without any hindrance and emerging from his crotch!
Time seems to have completely stopped at this moment.
The horror and despair on the face of the strong man God-King are forever frozen.
His burly and majestic body of the God King seemed to have been cut by the most precise laser, splitting silently into two halves along the central axis!
The incision is as smooth as a mirror, and you can even see the internal organs and bone sections that were instantly annihilated by the sword energy and lost all vitality!
The violent power of immortality lost the control of its master, and escaped from the cracked body like a headless fly. It was immediately completely annihilated by the remaining sword intent and turned into nothingness!
The two broken bodies, carrying the blood of the God King that was evaporated by the sword energy before they hit the ground, fell feebly towards the bloody desert below.
Fang Yu's figure appeared like a ghost in front of where the brawny God King originally stood, with his back to the fallen corpse.
He held the shining star sword in one hand, which was stained by no blood. The tip of the sword pointed diagonally at the bloody earth below, his posture was aloof and indifferent.
He didn't even glance at the corpse that was broken into two pieces. He just spoke calmly, his voice was calm without any ripples, but it contained the aloofness of looking down on the world.
"The bugs of the fourth level of the God King are just ants."
After the words fell, Fang Yu slowly turned around, his eyes as deep as cold stars, without any emotion, falling on the three immortal kings behind him who had been completely petrified.
At this moment, the charming smile on the face of the beautiful young woman had long since disappeared, replaced by unbelievable fear and paleness. Her delicate body was trembling uncontrollably. Her eyes looking at Fang Yu were like looking at a demon god crawling out of hell!
The sinister eyes of the tall and thin old man were filled with boundless horror, the knuckles holding the weapon turned white, the aura around him fluctuated violently, and the power of eternal life became chaotic!
Even the young God King, who had always been taciturn and had the most condensed aura, opened his eyes wide at this moment, with a look of fear on his face for the first time. His lips were slightly open, but he could not make any sound!
The air was dead silent, except for the subtle hum of the Star Sword and the muffled sound of two heavy bodies falling on the Gobi rocks from below the canyon.
Fang Yu's gaze, like the edge of a cold sword, slowly swept across the three faces filled with horror.
"It's your turn."
"Bang!"
Two pieces of the God King's body, as smooth as mirrors, fell on the bloody Gobi. The dull sound of the impact was like a death knell. Along with Fang Yu's words, it struck hard in the hearts of the remaining three God Kings of the Eternal Life Society.
The air seemed to be completely drained, and the silence was terrifying. Only the subtle hum of the Star Sword, like a whisper of death, echoed in the solidified space.
The charming smile on the face of the beautiful young woman had long since disappeared without a trace, replaced by unbelievable horror and bone-deep fear.
Her delicate body was shaking violently uncontrollably, and her eyes that were originally full of soul-stirring luster were now filled with boundless fear, staring at the lonely figure standing with a sword, as if looking at a demon god crawling out of the Nine Nether Abyss!
That understatement of the sword killed not only the fourth-level companions of the God King, but also her pride and courage as a God King!
"How...how is it possible..."
